engine: SQLite STRICT ANY (in-memory native SQLite driver)
case: arithmetic expression storage classes through typed CSV re-import
contract: The computed expressions value + 1, value / 2 and value / 0 retain independent fallback result metadata while native typeof() reports each runtime class.
Integer, REAL, numeric text, nonnumeric text, BLOB and SQL NULL inputs exercise SQLite arithmetic coercion; nonnumeric text and BLOB behave as zero for these expressions.
Adding 1 to 9223372036854775807 promotes the result to REAL, while integer division by 2 truncates and remains INTEGER; division by zero and NULL inputs produce SQL NULL.
Typed CSV export/import restores all computed values and runtime classes into STRICT ANY, verified with native typeof() on every destination cell.

native_contract_group.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app sqlite_ -- --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Other computed-expression shapes, additional consumer formats, spreadsheet-app re-import and installed editing remain open.
